snippet.title: Asteroid 69 Trailer (Released February 2026)
snippet.description:
Asteroids 69 Trailer Available on Steam Feb 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4209410/Asteroid_69/

Enjoy retro arcade action shooter style gameplay. 

You are the only hope as Rogue Asteroids have been spotted heading towards Earth. The experimental fleet of "Orbital Defense Force Vehicles" and weapons (pea shooter, rapid shot, double shot, etc) are at your fingertips. 

The Computron 9000 is your state of the Art Flight Computer (512kb of data storage) will deliver information through "floppy disks" that you unlock alongside Special Weapons and additional Ships.  Collect "coins" for a higher score and "energy capsules" to power up the Special Weapons quicker. 

Aliens and unusual Space Creatures will stand in your way through the treacherous levels.  Watch out for other surprises that can "blind side you" in the vacuum of space.  

Oh, by the way, do you need practice flying your ship?  There is a training mode you can use to try out each of the ships as you unlock them throughout your journey.  

Don't forget to watch for hints as you "save" the Earth from imminent danger. 

Use your favorite Keyboard or Game Pad (360, PS or various other brands). 

Single or Multiplayer Co Op up to 4 players (Steam Remote Play Together), Save your High Score, Clear all the Levels to Save the Earth, Customize your preferred controller

Made with Gamemaker
